notes: Player-measured cash/min at each crate tier, used to map progression (time to afford the next crate/rebirth). Each entry uses only items from that crate and the crates before it. Rules for every measurement: no code rewards, no achievement items, no secret items. Plot size is the build area actually used, not necessarily the player's full plot.

entries.notes: Built to avoid long AFK time.
Rebirth 1 (1M) was done during this tier. Its +2 plot size reward explains 19x19 -> 21x21, and its +1 luck is part of the luck increase.
No rebirth during this tier. The +3 plot size (21x21 -> 24x24) came from mastery.
Rebirth 2 (10B) was done during this tier. Its +4 plot size reward explains 24x24 -> 28x28, and its +1 luck is part of the luck increase.

Retested without Castle Fortress: 13T/min (first test with Castle Fortress was 9T). Castle Fortress's slow conveyor (speed 6) plus the longer route was costing throughput, most likely because the base is at the 100-ore cap. Rebirth 3 (50T) was done during this tier; its +1 unbox slot reward explains 1 -> 2 unbox slots (earlier tiers all had 1).
Rebirth 4 (10Qd) was done during this tier. Its +2 plot size reward explains 28x28 -> 30x30, and its +1 luck is part of the luck increase.
Rebirth 5 (25Qn) was done during this tier. Its +4 plot size reward explains 30x30 -> 34x34, and its +1 luck is part of the luck increase. First tier with Star Scanner and World Eater available.

assumptions: Player has enough AFK/offline enchanting time that Epic and Legendary items can be Shiny, Mythic and Shiny Mythic.
Player can AFK for rare items such as Moonstone Dropper and Dyson Module.

additionalAssumptions.assumption: Player has access to Star Scanner and World Eater.
